content.text: Hour-long bedtime fights are really common at 19 months. Toddlers this age are testing limits, and a bedtime that's too early can make it worse. Tonight, try a short, identical wind-down: bath, books, lights out, the same few words every time. Then put Remy in the crib or bed awake and stay calm and boring if they protest. Keep the same steps every night, because the predictability is what makes it stick.
